newsitem.title: USA: Swisher sees earnings, revenue growth.
newsitem.headline: Swisher sees earnings, revenue growth.

text.p: Swisher International Inc said on Tuesday that two recent deals should help the company exceed analysts' expectations for the first quarter.

The company is comfortable that it should report revenue growth of 30 to 40 percent and earnings growth of 60 percent or more in the quarter ended January 1997, Patrick Swisher, president and chief executive officer, said.
The company reported last year's first quarter sales of $2.27 million and earnings of $88,000, or $0.05 a share.
Swisher said it has signed a Surface Doctor franchise contract for $154,000 and it expects to sign its first Swisher Hygiene Master franchise license in the United Kingdom during the quarter.
